# THE NIGHT MARKET
[color=#8CFF5A][bold]-- STALLS OPEN --[/bold][/color]
[italic]Lanterns go up at shift change on {colony}. The price is what the board says until the board says something else.[/italic]
Sellers post their own lines. The Market takes a tenth from both ends and vouches for nobody. Read the [netlink="house rules" link="bloodmarket.deep/rules"] before you message anyone, or skip them and learn them the expensive way.
## CONTRABAND - Real coffee, Earth roast, vacuum brick. [color=#FF4A3D]180 cr[/color]. Seller: GREYHEN - Still-house spirits, hydroponics mash, two litres. [color=#FF4A3D]40 cr[/color] or six ration chits. Seller: TALLOWMAN - Headset scrambler, buys you one quiet hour off the garrison channel. [color=#FF4A3D]650 cr[/color]. Seller: SHORTWAVE SAL - Working Joe, inhibitors pulled, does not report to anyone. Price on request. Seller: KNOCKOFF
## PAPERS - Colonist identity card, blank laminate stock. [color=#FF4A3D]900 cr[/color], face and name extra. Seller: INKWELL - ICC trade license, crew grade, two years of clean history. [color=#FF4A3D]2,400 cr[/color]. Seller: INKWELL - Company work record, disciplinary page removed. [color=#FF4A3D]1,100 cr[/color]. Seller: CLERK-9 - Bunk on an outbound hauler, no luggage, no questions. Ask. Seller: FERRYMAN
## SURPLUS - Rifle magazines, UA issue, ten in the wax wrap, from the pullout stockpiles. [color=#FF4A3D]300 cr[/color]. Seller: NOT-A-QUARTERMASTER - Armour plates, garrison pattern, one cracked and priced to match. [color=#FF4A3D]220 cr[/color]. Seller: NOT-A-QUARTERMASTER - Night goggles, left tube dead. [color=#FF4A3D]1,300 cr[/color]. Seller: OWL - Field rations, case of twenty four. Two taste of the box. [color=#FF4A3D]95 cr[/color]. Seller: MESS SERGEANT
## PHARMACY - Oxycodone autoinjectors, medbay stock, lot numbers ground off. [color=#FF4A3D]160 cr[/color] each. Seller: NURSE NOBODY - Synthetic blood, two bags, cold chain broken twice. [color=#FF4A3D]400 cr[/color]. Seller: NURSE NOBODY - Mine shift stims, thirty hours awake, heart not included. [color=#FF4A3D]25 cr[/color] a strip. Seller: DOCTOR SUNDAY
[color=#FF4A3D]!! PRICE FEED STALE: SURPLUS COLUMN NOT UPDATED SINCE THE LAST RAID !![/color]
Nothing heavier than a rifle goes on this board. Heavier goes through the Freelancers on Irkala, and they do not take messages from strangers.
Before a meet, check [netlink="marshalwatch.deep" link="marshalwatch.deep"]. If your seller stops answering, try [netlink="missing.deep" link="missing.deep"].
